description: This file defines types, structs, classes, and function pointers for an RBus API implementation, including abstract class RBusApiImpl for core functionalities and RBusApi as a static interface.

classes.name: RBusApiImpl
classes.description: Abstract class defining the core interface for RBus operations, to be implemented for specific behaviors.

classes.name: RBusApi
classes.description: Wrapper class providing static interface for RBus functionalities, managing an implementation object.

methods.name: RBusApi()
methods.description: Constructor for RBusApi, initializes static implementation pointer.

methods.name: RBusApi(const RBusApi &obj)
methods.description: Deleted copy constructor to prevent copying.

methods.name: setImpl
methods.description: Sets the static implementation pointer to a new RBusApiImpl instance.

methods.name: rbus_open
methods.description: Static method to open a connection to RBus.

methods.name: rbusObject_GetValue
methods.description: Retrieves a value from an RBus object.

methods.name: rbusValue_GetString
methods.description: Converts an RBus value to a string representation.

methods.name: rbusValue_SetString
methods.description: Sets a string value in an RBus value object.

methods.name: rbus_set
methods.description: Sets a value in RBus with optional session options.

methods.name: rbusValue_Release
methods.description: Releases resources held by an RBus value.
